name: Spa-Francorchamps
notes: Approximate first-pass braking-zone map for ACC telemetry. Distances are lap-distance ranges inferred from early user captures and should be refined with more clean laps.

braking_zones.name: Eau Rouge/Raidillon/Kemmel
braking_zones.notes: Usually not a normal heavy braking zone in GT3, but useful for lift or confidence analysis later.

braking_zones.name: Les Combes/Malmedy
braking_zones.notes: Heavy braking at the end of Kemmel plus the following right-left sequence.

braking_zones.name: No Name/Pouhon Entry
braking_zones.notes: Transition into the high-speed middle sector.

braking_zones.name: Pouhon/Fagnes
braking_zones.notes: Fast left and later braking into the Fagnes complex.

braking_zones.name: Campus/Stavelot
braking_zones.notes: Exit-critical right-hand sequence before the run to Blanchimont.

braking_zones.name: Bus Stop
braking_zones.notes: Final chicane and major braking zone.
